header.title: AFT BLOCK A: DANFOSS PVG 32 - 4 FUNCTIONS / HYDRAULIC SYSTEM

extraction.notes: Sheet shows an inlet section at left (with pressure relief / filter symbols, code near '300' and code '11166838') and two auxiliary standalone valves EV-8.5 and EV-8.6 at far right, each with A/B 1/4"G ports, not part of the 4 main PVG function slices - marked is_block_level. Cartridge/component part numbers (e.g., 157B5111, 157B6203, 157B2014, 157B7020, 157B7126, 11166838, 11166832) and pressure setting values on red triangle callouts (labeled '9' and '10') are present but too small to fully verify at this resolution. Red triangle warning numbers (9, 10) correspond to revision-history pressure adjustment notes; exact valve internals and spring/pressure values illegible.

slices.label: TENDER CAR CONTROLLER
slices.actuation: PVE☐ solenoid actuated, ON/OFF type; neutral position = open neutral (spool center connects P to T when not actuated)

detail.function: TENDER CAR CONTROLLER (EV-8.1) - PVG 32 Module, function block, sheet: AFT block A
detail.actuation: PVE☐ solenoid actuated, ON/OFF type; neutral position = open neutral (spool center connects P to T when not actuated)

cartridges.role: Main directional PVG spool, ON/OFF solenoid (PVE) actuated, open-neutral center; IN=A / OUT=B as printed
cartridges.position_in_flow: sits between P (pressure rail) and A/B work ports; part 157B7120 marked on spool body

cartridges.role: Solenoid pilot valve on top of main spool, drives PVE actuation of the directional spool
cartridges.position_in_flow: pilot stage above main spool, fed from small pilot line, part 11166838 marked on cap

cartridges.role: Work-port relief valve on B side (LS_B branch), protects B line, dumps excess to tank/return rail when opened
cartridges.position_in_flow: sits in the LS_B/B work line, downstream of the shuttle/orifice pair, vents to T rail
cartridges.setting: 100 (setting value as marked, units not stated, likely bar)

cartridges.role: Work-port relief valve on A side (LS_A branch), protects A line, dumps excess to tank/return rail when opened
cartridges.position_in_flow: sits in the LS_A/A work line, mirrors the B-side relief, vents to T rail
cartridges.setting: 100 (setting value as marked, units not stated, likely bar)

cartridges.role: LS pressure limiter cartridge, red triangle callout '9' labeled 157B7020, limits load-sense signal pressure feeding the LS rail
cartridges.position_in_flow: in the LS line branching off toward LS_A/LS_B rail, adjustable via allen key per notes block
cartridges.setting: 225 bar increased to 260 bar (per notes block, quarter turn clockwise)

cartridges.role: Inlet/system relief valve, ON/OFF relief protecting P inlet, vents to T rail when system pressure exceeds setting
cartridges.position_in_flow: in the P (pressure) line near bottom-left of the sub-circuit, upstream of the main spool, adjustable via allen key
cartridges.setting: 150 bar increased to 225 bar (per notes block, one full turn clockwise)

cartridges.role: Secondary/backup relief valve in the pressure line, set to a fixed lower threshold, protects circuit branch feeding the main relief stage
cartridges.position_in_flow: stacked directly below the inlet relief valve in the P line, upstream of the diamond check symbol

cartridges.role: Pilot-operated check / non-return valve (diamond symbol) in the P supply line, prevents backflow toward pump/inlet
cartridges.position_in_flow: in the P line, between the 300-bar relief and the main P rail junction

cartridges.role: Shuttle/orifice pair (circle with <O> symbol) in the LS_A and LS_B lines, used to select/dampen the load-sense signal
cartridges.position_in_flow: in-line on LS_A and LS_B branches just upstream of the 100-setting reliefs, before joining LS rail at bottom of sheet

flow_scenarios: Neutral (open-neutral spool, not energized): P connects through open-center spool to T return rail; no flow to A or B work ports; LS line unloaded (no load signal generated)

Energized (PVE ON): spool shifts, P->A port (IN=A) supplying flow out, B port returns to T (OUT=B) per printed IN=A/OUT=B label; LS signal taken from the active work line and routed through LS_A/LS_B shuttle/orifice pair to LS rail at bottom
Over-pressure on A work line: A-side relief (100 setting) opens when A line exceeds threshold, dumping excess to T return rail
Over-pressure on B work line: B-side relief (100 setting) opens when B line exceeds threshold, dumping excess to T return rail
System inlet over-pressure: main inlet relief (150->225 bar) opens, venting P line to T rail to protect pump/circuit
LS signal over-pressure: LS limiter cartridge 157B7020 (225->260 bar) opens to cap the load-sense pressure signal feeding LS rail
settings: 100 (work-port reliefs on A and B, units not printed, presumed bar)
150 bar -> 225 bar (inlet/ON-OFF relief valve, per notes block)
225 bar -> 260 bar (LS limiter 157B7020/157B7126, per notes block)
300 (secondary relief in P line, units not printed, presumed bar)
ports: A - work port, connects to red line running right then down into the sub-circuit toward main spool A; continues off top of crop toward external actuator (off-sheet)
B - work port, similar red line, connects toward main spool B; continues off top of crop (off-sheet)
P - pressure supply port, at bottom of sheet, connects to P rail runs across bottom horizontal red line, labeled 157B5111 and 157B6203 pipe codes
T - tank return port, at bottom-left, connects to return rail running along bottom of sheet
LS_A - load sense line for A, bottom of sheet, joins LS rail
LS_B - load sense line for B, bottom of sheet, joins LS rail

Full part number suffix on 157B7120 spool cartridge (possible additional digits cut off)

detail.function: TENDER HAUL. WINCH — EV-8.2 (PVG32 module, PVEΘ ON/OFF, spool 10 lt/min, IN=A/OUT=B, closed neutral position)
detail.actuation: PVEΘ solenoid ON/OFF actuation (two-position); closed neutral position (spool center blocks P, A and B)

cartridges.role: Main directional control spool, ON/OFF solenoid actuated, 2-position (closed center)
cartridges.position_in_flow: Sits across P (top rail 157B6203), A and B work ports; in neutral all ports blocked; energized shifts to connect P->A and B->T (per IN=A/OUT=B labeling)

cartridges.role: Work-port relief valve on B side load-holding section
cartridges.position_in_flow: Mounted on the vertical work-section body below the spool; small relief symbol at top of the section vents to the T return rail at bottom of crop
cartridges.setting: increased from 150 bar to 225 bar (per note, clockwise one turn)

cartridges.role: Pilot-operated check / load-holding valve on work port line
cartridges.position_in_flow: In series with A/B port line below main spool, check element with pilot line drawn to LS/pilot rail; unconfirmed which port exactly due to crop

cartridges.role: LS pressure limiter cartridge (labeled 134)
cartridges.position_in_flow: Two identical cartridges labeled 134 sit in the LS_A / LS_B lines near bottom, between work section and LS rail, venting/limiting to LS rail
cartridges.setting: unconfirmed exact value; labeled 134 (likely bar) — not the one being adjusted per notes

cartridges.role: Shuttle/selector element in LS line
cartridges.position_in_flow: Small circle with <O> bracket symbol on LS_B and LS_A lines near bottom rail, appears to be a shuttle or isolation symbol in the LS return path

flow_scenarios: Neutral (de-energized): spool closed-center — P, A, B all blocked at main spool; LS line at low/tank pressure via LS shuttle path
Energized (ON): P -> spool -> A port (IN=A); B port -> spool -> T (OUT=B); load-holding check/relief on B maintains back-pressure until relief setting is exceeded
Relief scenario: if B-side (or work section) pressure exceeds relief cartridge 157B7020 setting (225 bar after adjustment), it dumps to T return rail protecting the circuit
LS limiter scenario: cartridges (134) limit/clamp LS_A and LS_B pressure lines feeding back to pump LS rail, independent of main spool position
settings: ON/OFF relief valve (157B7020): increased from 150 bar to 225 bar, adjusted by turning allen key clockwise one turn
LSA limiter cartridges labeled 134: exact bar value not legible/confirmed in this crop
ports: A: labeled port at top of work section, connects down into work-section body, off to load circuit (off-sheet below crop)
B: labeled port at top of work section, similarly routed into work-section body, off-sheet below crop
P/T rail: horizontal red line labeled 157B6203 running along top, shared bus across modules
LS_A, LS_B: labeled lines at bottom of crop feeding into LS rail, partially off-sheet
illegible: Exact identifier/type of the pilot-operated check/load-holding cartridge body in the work section
Exact pressure value stamped on 134-labeled cartridges
Full routing of A and B ports beyond the visible work-section box (continues off-sheet downward)
Small valve symbols at very bottom of crop near LS_B/LS_A labels — partially cut off

slices.label: SECONDARY WINCH STBD
slices.actuation: Proportional electro-hydraulic actuation, PVEU 0-10V analogue signal. 1° & 3° positions: <5V=A port, 2° position: >5V=B port. Open-center (open neutral) position at rest.

detail.function: SECONDARY WINCH STBD (left column, partial) / PRIMARY WINCH STBD (right column, EV-8.4) - PVG32 module winch control
detail.actuation: Proportional electro-hydraulic actuation, PVEU 0-10V analogue signal. 1° & 3° positions: <5V=A port, 2° position: >5V=B port. Open-center (open neutral) position at rest.

cartridges.role: Main proportional directional spool (PVG32, EV-8.4) for Primary Winch STBD
cartridges.position_in_flow: Sits on pressure rail 157B6203; P supplied from top rail, spool meters flow to A/B work ports of Primary Winch actuator; open-center neutral connects rail through to downstream module

cartridges.role: Pilot-operated/relief cartridge above main spool block (small valve with adjustable spring symbol, unlabeled)
cartridges.position_in_flow: Mounted directly above the main spool in the Primary Winch valve stack; inlet from work line, outlet appears to loop back into the same block - not traceable to tank or LS rail in this crop

cartridges.role: LS pressure limiter/relief cartridge labeled 260, on LS_A line
cartridges.position_in_flow: Sits in the LS_A branch downstream of the Primary Winch spool; inlet from LS_A line, outlet drawn into the blue LS rail returning toward pump LS manifold (off crop)

cartridges.role: LS pressure limiter/relief cartridge labeled 260, on LS_B line (Secondary Winch side, mirrored)
cartridges.position_in_flow: Sits in LS_B branch on the left (Secondary Winch) stack; inlet from LS_B line, outlet into blue LS rail

cartridges.role: On/off relief valve cartridge (EV-8.5), small block with coil and spring/relief symbol labeled 225 bar (per notes: increased from 150 to 225 bar)
cartridges.position_in_flow: Sits below/adjacent to work ports A (1/4"G) and B (1/4"G) at bottom of Primary Winch STBD stack; A port line runs down and off crop with red triangle '10' warning; B port line runs down and off crop with red triangle '10' warning

cartridges.role: Shuttle/check element at top of primary valve block (diamond symbol with X)
cartridges.position_in_flow: Located at top of 11166832 valve stack, appears to combine/select pilot signal lines before feeding spool actuation stages - not traceable further in crop

flow_scenarios: Neutral (open-center): pump supply on 157B6203 rail flows through open-center spool position and continues to downstream/next module on the rail; no flow to A or B work ports; LS line unloaded (dashed cyan LS rail at low pressure)

Energized <5V (1st/3rd position, A actuation): P from rail -> spool -> A port -> off-sheet to Primary Winch motor/actuator; return from B port -> spool -> tank rail (blue) -> off-sheet; LS_A line senses load pressure and signals pump via LS rail, limited by 260 bar limiter cartridge in LS_A branch
Energized >5V (2nd position, B actuation): P from rail -> spool -> B port -> off-sheet; return from A port -> spool -> tank; LS_B line senses load, limited by 260 bar limiter cartridge in LS_B branch

EV-8.5 on/off relief function: when energized, pilot/relief valve opens allowing A or B port line (1/4"G, off-sheet downward) to relieve at its set pressure (225 bar per adjacent note) - exact tank routing not traceable in this crop
settings: LS limiter cartridges (both A and B sides): 260 bar (labeled '260' on cartridge bodies)
EV-8.5 relief valve: 225 bar (per note block: increased from 150 bar to 225 bar by one full turn clockwise) - setting not printed on cartridge itself in this crop, taken from adjacent notes_block
Red triangle callouts '10' throughout - meaning of numeral not defined in this crop (cross-reference note not visible here)

composition.serve_who: This sheet ("AFT BLOCK A: DANFOSS PVG 32 - 4 FUNCTIONS") is a Danfoss PVG 32 hydraulic valve block (node 570-danfoss-pvg-32-aft-blocka) with four proportional/on-off function slices, each labelled with the piece of deck equipment it drives: TENDER CAR CONTROLLER (EV-8.1) -> 270-tender-car-antal-ld1500; TENDER HAUL. WINCH (EV-8.2) -> 270-tender-winch-warn-hy2000; SECONDARY WINCH STBD (EV-8.3) -> 220-secondary-winch-stbd; PRIMARY WINCH STBD (EV-8.4) -> 220-primary-winch-stbd. The two auxiliary standalone valves EV-8.5/EV-8.6 at far right are drawn as separate 1/4"G on/off valves not tied under any of the four labelled function boxes and are treated as block-level auxiliary outputs (infrastructure) rather than a named winch function, since no label/legend ties them to one of the four equipment titles. The P/T/LS_A/LS_B rails, inlet relief/filter stage (labelled 300, with pilot check), and the ON/OFF inlet relief (150->225 bar) are shared block infrastructure, not attributable to a single function.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Function slice EV-8.1 is explicitly titled 'TENDER CAR CONTROLLER' in its own header/spec block on this sheet, matching the register mapping to the Antal LD1500 tender car controller.

functions.label: Tender Car Controller drive (EV-8.1)
functions.what_it_does: Meters hydraulic flow to the tender car actuator to move the car in/out along its track (IN=A / OUT=B), returning oil to tank when idle.
key_components: Main directional PVG spool (ON/OFF, open-neutral center)
Pilot solenoid module (PVE ON/OFF) driving the spool
Work-port relief valve on A line (100, protects A work line, vents to T)
Work-port relief valve on B line (100, protects B work line, vents to T)
LS pressure limiter cartridge (157B7020) capping the load-sense signal feeding the LS rail
Shuttle/orifice pair on LS_A/LS_B lines selecting/damping the load-sense signal

flow_scenarios.path: P rail flows through open center of spool directly to T return rail; no flow reaches work ports A or B; LS line stays unloaded

P -> spool shifts -> out port A -> off-sheet to tender car actuator; actuator return -> port B -> spool -> T return rail; load-sense signal taken from active work line, passed through LS_A/LS_B shuttle/orifice pair to LS rail, capped by LS limiter cartridge 157B7020 at 225 bar increased to 260 bar (quarter turn clockwise on allen key)
A-side relief (set 100, units presumed bar) opens, dumping excess A-line oil to T return rail
B-side relief (set 100, units presumed bar) opens, dumping excess B-line oil to T return rail

functions.dry_data: PVG32 module; PVE ON/OFF pilot actuation; spool rated 10 lt/min; IN=A/OUT=B; open-neutral center.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Function slice EV-8.2 is explicitly titled 'TENDER HAUL. WINCH' with its own spec block, matching the register mapping to the WARN HY2000 tender hauling winch.

functions.label: Tender Hauling Winch drive (EV-8.2)
functions.what_it_does: Meters hydraulic flow to haul the tender in via the winch drum (IN=A/OUT=B), holding load in neutral via closed-center spool.
key_components: Main directional PVG spool, ON/OFF solenoid, closed-neutral center (blocks P, A, B at rest)
Work-port relief / ON-OFF relief valve protecting the work section, adjusted from 150 bar to 225 bar (allen key, one turn clockwise)
Pilot-operated check / load-holding valve in the work port line, holding winch load when spool is neutral
LS pressure limiter cartridges (labelled 134) in LS_A/LS_B branches limiting load-sense signal to LS rail

flow_scenarios.path: P, A and B all blocked at the main spool; load-holding check valve retains pressure on the loaded work port so winch does not slip; LS line held near tank/low pressure via shuttle path

P -> spool -> out port A -> off-sheet to winch motor (haul-in); winch motor return -> port B -> spool -> T return rail; load-holding check valve on the loaded line maintains back-pressure until the ON/OFF relief setting is exceeded

If pressure on the work section exceeds the ON/OFF relief cartridge setting (originally 150 bar, increased to 225 bar by one turn clockwise on the allen key), it opens and dumps to the T return rail, protecting the winch circuit

functions.dry_data: PVG32 module; PVE ON/OFF pilot actuation; spool rated 10 lt/min; IN=A/OUT=B; closed-neutral center.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Function slice EV-8.3 is explicitly titled 'SECONDARY WINCH STBD' with its own spec block (PVEU proportional, 130 lt/min TBC), matching the register mapping for the Secondary Winch STBD.

functions.label: Secondary Winch STBD proportional drive (EV-8.3)
functions.what_it_does: Proportionally meters flow to drive the secondary winch drum in either rotation direction under a 0-10V analogue command, with load-sense feedback limited to protect the circuit.
key_components: LS pressure limiter/relief cartridge on LS_A line, marked 260 (increased from 225 bar to 260 bar, quarter turn clockwise)
LS pressure limiter/relief cartridge on LS_B line, marked 260 (mirrored setting)
Shuttle/check element combining pilot signal lines at top of valve stack

flow_scenarios.path: Pump supply on the P rail passes through the open-center spool and continues to the downstream module; no flow reaches work ports A/B; LS line unloaded

P -> spool meters proportional flow -> work port A -> off-sheet to secondary winch drive; return from B -> spool -> T rail; LS_A line senses load and signals pump via LS rail, capped by the 260 bar limiter cartridge (increased from 225 to 260 bar, quarter turn clockwise)

P -> spool meters proportional flow -> work port B -> off-sheet to secondary winch drive (opposite rotation); return from A -> spool -> T rail; LS_B line senses load, capped by its 260 bar limiter cartridge

functions.dry_data: PVG32 module; PVEU proportional 0-10V pilot; spool rated 130 lt/min (TBC); 1°&3°<5V=A, 2°>5V=B; open-neutral center.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Function slice EV-8.4 is explicitly titled 'PRIMARY WINCH STBD' with its own spec block (PVEU proportional, 130 lt/min TBC), matching the register mapping for the Primary Winch STBD.

functions.label: Primary Winch STBD proportional drive (EV-8.4)
functions.what_it_does: Proportionally meters flow to drive the primary winch drum in either rotation direction under a 0-10V analogue command, with load-sense feedback limited to protect the circuit.
key_components: Main proportional directional spool (PVEU 0-10V pilot, part marked 11166832)
LS pressure limiter/relief cartridge on LS_A line marked 260 bar (increased from 225 bar, quarter turn clockwise)
LS pressure limiter/relief cartridge on LS_B line marked 260 bar (mirrored)
Shuttle/check element at top of valve stack combining pilot signal lines

flow_scenarios.path: Pump supply on the P rail passes through the open-center spool and continues on the rail; no flow reaches work ports A/B; LS line unloaded

P -> spool meters proportional flow -> work port A -> off-sheet to primary winch drive; return from B -> spool -> T rail; LS_A senses load, capped by 260 bar limiter cartridge (increased from 225 to 260 bar, quarter turn clockwise)
P -> spool meters proportional flow -> work port B -> off-sheet to primary winch drive (opposite rotation); return from A -> spool -> T rail; LS_B senses load, capped by its 260 bar limiter cartridge

functions.dry_data: PVG32 module; PVEU proportional 0-10V pilot; spool rated 130 lt/min (TBC); 1°&3°<5V=A, 2°>5V=B; open-neutral center.

facts: Block-level P (pressure), T (tank/return), LS_A and LS_B rails run horizontally across the bottom of all four function slices, shared by all modules (pipe codes 157B5111, 157B6203, 157B2014).

Inlet section at far left includes a filter, a secondary/backup relief valve set to 300 (units presumed bar) in the P line upstream of a pilot-operated check/non-return valve, protecting the pump/inlet before the main P rail junction.
Inlet/system ON-OFF relief valve in the P line was increased from 150 bar to 225 bar (one full turn clockwise on the allen key) per the revision-history note, protecting the whole block's P supply.

Two auxiliary standalone valves EV-8.5 and EV-8.6, each with A/B 1/4"G work ports, sit to the right of the four main function slices; they are drawn independently of the four labelled equipment titles and are treated as block-level auxiliary on/off outputs rather than being attributed to any of the four named winches/controllers.

Revision markers (red triangles numbered 9 and 10) on this sheet correspond to the pressure-adjustment history rows in the title-block revision table (rev 8 'PRESSURE AFTER COMMISSIONING', rev 9 'PRESSURE ADJUSTEMENT', rev 10 'PROPORTIONAL AFT WINCHES').

uncertainties: Exact units on the '100' relief settings for EV-8.1's A/B work-port reliefs are not printed in this crop (presumed bar per sheet convention).
Exact units and confirmed value on the '300' secondary relief in the inlet P line (presumed bar).
Exact LS limiter cartridge value on EV-8.2 (labelled '134') not confirmed/legible.

EV-8.5 and EV-8.6 valve function (which equipment they serve, if any) is not labelled or traceable to a named function box on this sheet region; their downstream A/B 1/4"G port routing continues off-sheet and is not resolvable here.

Whether the red LSA-pressure adjustment note text next to EV-8.4/EV-8.6 area targets the Primary Winch STBD LS limiter specifically or an adjacent unlabeled circuit is not fully confirmed from the crop.

Part number suffixes/full IDs on some cartridges (e.g., 157B7120, small pilot check symbols) are illegible; per convention these are not treated as functional uncertainties, only noted as 'capture at inspection if needed'.
